title: Engine API: evaluate one recipe
description: POST body and reply of the engine API. The web app sends the form, the Kitchen Profile, the picked idea and the recipe the model wrote; the engine returns the Meal result with packs, macros and leftovers computed in code. No model call happens here.

profile.description: The user's Kitchen Profile. Omitted: the default profile (prompts/kitchen-profile.default.json).

prices.description: Optional prices the user typed (saved in their browser), one per food and pack size. Omitted or empty: no line has a price, the budget check is marked incomplete and the reply is the same as before prices existed. A price for a size that is not one of the food's typical packs is ignored. The same food and pack size twice is a 422.

country.description: Optional country for estimated prices. "ES": every line without a user price gets an estimated pack price from Spain's average prices (MAPA household panel, data/open/prices/es.json), with price_source "estimate"; the user's prices always win. Omitted: no estimates and the reply is the same as before estimates existed.

Price.description: Price of one pack: food is the English food key of the pack line (line.food), pack_grams the weight of one pack as the line shows it (grams_bought / packs_to_buy; for eggs units x 51 g, e.g. 612 for 12; for loose items the unit, e.g. 1000).
